_comment: Drift guard for scripts/audit/validate-robots.mjs. Lists the AI-crawler User-agent sections that src/pages/robots.txt.ts is expected to keep blocking from the visual dashboard while allowing /llms.txt (the 'AI scraping/training bots' block) -- captured from the live robots.txt on 2026-07-16. A MISSING entry is a fail (regression: a bot lost its Disallow rule). An EXTRA entry in the live file that isn't listed here is a warn (update this snapshot to intentionally acknowledge the addition).
